stories.subject: Stage 1: Tier-0 predicate + f(attempt) demotion + history gate + stream publish hook
acceptanceCriteria: degenerateReply guard (usage present AND textOut.length===0 AND not aborted) placed before BOTH src/harness/opencode.ts prompt() exits; aborted-no-text excluded (handled at flows/port-project.ts:563)
modelOverride threaded runReviewTurn -> runAgentTurn; policy f(attempt): attempt>=2 on review steps demotes from OPENCODE_REVIEWER_MODEL default; no env mutation
Lead-layer dispatch gate: reads dexcli flow history only (typed parser reuse), stale = newest relevant event age >10min, 5s query timeout, fail-open with 'gate: degraded' surfaced in runner output

Envelope factory WriteStream publish to port/<flowId>/events with try/catch-swallow at every call site; Step-0 probe confirms WriteStream callable from worker step context (else publish moves to runner-side, deviation recorded)
Unit tests: degenerate fixtures route retryable; healthy negatives pass; demotion policy = pure f(shape, attempt); WriteStream outage cannot fail a step
stories.evidence: commit 68b1577 (guard in seam +52, demotion threading, scripts/dispatch-gate.ts 212 lines, envelope stream hook +110); bun test 216/0; tsc clean (fresh)

stories.subject: Stage 2a: vitest triage as declared Lane-B gate
acceptanceCriteria: QueueVerifyStep persists parsed failure records into the durable vitest queue attribute (beyond totals)

classifyMany at queue-build writes {failureClass, attributedFile, reason} per record; unknown attribution -> port-caused (documented); Jev usage via recordJevUsage pattern; FailureClassification extended with attributedFile
Fix-round feed = existing per-file fix loop reading queue state; consumer test asserts classified records reach the feed and route to attributedFile
Jev unavailability -> naive classifier fallback (fail-open test); consumer registered in src/judgment-registry.ts with threshold + provenance

AC-T manifest at tests/fixtures/vitest-triage/manifest.json (id/evidence-path/label/adjudication-note); promotion only if >=20 cases AND >=5/class AND >=90% overall AND >=80% per class, else stays non-default with shortfall recorded
stories.evidence: commit 8c835ea (7 files, +795/-14); fresh 236/0 tests + tsc clean; registry has vitest-triage + citation-check; AC-T shortfall honestly recorded (0 adjudicated cases, classifier stays non-default)

stories.subject: Stage 2c: verdict repair-or-discard + exhaustion tombstones
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic suspicion predicate (span-outside-diff; all-blockers>5; in-step verbatim-repeat vs repaired reply) — no Tier-1 input (Lane A)

Tombstone variant {reviewer, discarded, reason, attempt, tokens} tolerated by BOTH VerdictCheckStep (:1029-1034) and PrepVerdictCheckStep (:1629-1632); discarded reviewer -> zero kept findings; surviving reviewer proceeds; round surfaces unreviewed; prep-loop termination verified against PrepLoopDecisionStep

Attempt exhaustion (deterministic) -> both reviewers tombstoned -> degraded round -> flow reaches terminal-success; degraded marker asserted on metrics render + /api/state + dashboard headline + AC1/AC2 report surfaces
Tombstoned tokens carried on tombstone + envelope tokens return; AC2 under-count (attempts 1..n-1 lost per 0(g)) stated explicitly in the report
tests/verdict-repair.test.ts covers: triggered repair, repair success, repair-fail->tombstone, single-reviewer-discard, zero-reviewer degraded round; agreement.ts untouched

LIVE: dashboard renders from the ReadStream subscriber during a real run with >=1 event observed arriving via subscription (not poll fallback), poll fallback demonstrated on forced failure
